title: India Celebrates Ganesha Chaturthi with Various Rituals and Festivities
summary: Ganesha Chaturthi is a Hindu festival celebrated on the second day of the bright half of the month of Bhadrapada. This year, it falls on August 2, 2026. The festival marks the birth of Lord Ganesha, the remover of obstacles. On this day, devotees observe a fast and perform various rituals, including the worship of Ganesha and the recitation of sacred texts. The festival is also associated with the concept of 'panchak' and 'sarvarthasiddhi yog', which are believed to bring good fortune and prosperity.
summary_points: The festival marks the birth of Lord Ganesha
Devotees observe a fast and perform various rituals
